description: Quality gates for CI (Lab 10). Tune per rubric: stricter = fewer false positives shipped; looser = more regressions slip through.

average_faithfulness.rationale: Blog outputs often score low vs short RAG contexts; 0.04 catches near-zero/NaN failures. +10% (~0.044) slightly tightens hallucination guard; -10% (~0.036) risks accepting more ungrounded prose.

average_answer_relevancy.rationale: Relevancy should stay well above random; 0.55 matches conservative smoke runs. +10% (~0.605) rejects more off-topic drafts; -10% (~0.495) allows drift toward generic filler.
